QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 6 (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: You brought the Blue Ink to Cole, but he seems to have another request.
QuestInfo.1: The key to the Speaking Hall broke and they need a new key immediately.
QuestInfo.2: Hurry the items over to Cole!

0.0: Today is absolutely not going right for us. I was setting up the microphone in the Speaking Room and the Grays brought in Zeno! He REALLY wanted one of those t-shirts we made. Take this key and...\n(You hear a snapping sound.)
0.1:
Oh geez. I knew I should have paid for American made keys. 
Change of plans! I just happen to be an expert keymaker and I know the Grays will have all the parts I need. I'll give you a list. Hurry up, okay?

yes.0: Zeno's going on a rampage looking for extra shirts in there. You have to hurry up and get the keymaking supplies!

no.0: Are you really going to let all this work we've done be for nothing?

1.0: Did you bring them? Thank goodness!

yes.0:
Watch the master at work!
(Cole whips up a new keymaking press, and a key, in a jiffy.)
yes.1: Good to know I can always fall back on my true passion... making keys.

item.0: Backing out at the end?! What kind of main character are you?
